Here is the solution:

**Total Cards:** $17 \text{ boxes} \times 24 \text{ cards/box} = 408 \text{ cards}$

**Cards Given Away:** $138 \text{ cards} + 97 \text{ cards} = 235 \text{ cards}$

**Remaining Cards:** $408 \text{ total cards} - 235 \text{ given away} = 173 \text{ cards}$

---
**Answer:**

* **Total Cards:** 408
* **Calculation:** $(17 \times 24) - (138 + 97) = 408 - 235 = 173$
* **Remaining Cards:** 173
